scenarios.title: Same Room
scenarios.text: At a club gala, {P} is on his arm, and across the room is {F}, in a red dress, looking right at him. {P} follows his eyes. 'Who's that?'
scenarios.prompt: Your partner and your crush are in the same room.

out.text: {P} nods. {F} leaves early. Nothing happens, except the knot in his stomach for the rest of the night.
{F} comes over and says hello like they're old friends. {P} watches the whole thing with a frozen smile.

choices.label: Introduce them and keep it light
choices.text: He introduces them. {F} is polite. {P} is very polite. In the car home, {P} says, 'She likes you.' It isn't a question.

choices.label: Take {P} home early
choices.text: He fakes a headache and they leave. {P} is pleased to be home early. {F} sends a single message: a question mark.

scenarios.title: {Pf}'s Colleague
scenarios.text: {Pf} mentions a colleague more and more: his jokes, his advice, a lunch they had. When {J} asks about him, she changes the subject a little too quickly.
scenarios.prompt: Your partner might be drifting towards someone else.

choices.label: Ask her honestly
choices.hint: The truth is better than guessing.

out.text: She admits she's been lonely and that the colleague listens. Nothing happened. Something nearly did. They talk until three.
She says he's being paranoid. Maybe he is. Maybe he isn't.

choices.label: Win her back
choices.text: He starts coming home on time, asking about her days, planning weekends. The colleague stops being mentioned.

choices.label: Check her messages
choices.text: He checks. There's nothing there except a woman who's lonely. He feels sick. She never finds out. He knows.

scenarios.title: She Wants a Family
scenarios.text: {Pf} has been quiet all evening. Finally: 'I want children. Soon. I don't know if you do.' He has honestly never thought about it.
scenarios.prompt: Your partner wants children.

choices.label: 'So do I.'
choices.text: She cries. He cries. They start thinking about names that very night, and disagreeing about all of them.

choices.label: 'Let's wait until I retire.'
choices.text: She nods slowly. 'And if that's ten years?' He doesn't have an answer.

choices.label: Be honest that you're unsure
choices.text: They talk about it honestly for hours. No decision. But no pretending either.

scenarios.title: Loss
scenarios.text: {Pf} calls from the hospital. The pregnancy they hadn't told anyone about is over. She sounds very small on the phone. He's at the training ground with a match tomorrow.
scenarios.prompt: Your partner has had a miscarriage.

choices.label: Go to her now. Miss the match.
choices.text: He's at the hospital in thirty minutes. He holds her for hours. The club tells the press he has 'a family matter'. They never say more.

choices.label: Go to her and play the match after
choices.text: He spends the night at the hospital and plays the next day on no sleep. He doesn't remember any of the match.

scenarios.title: The Date
scenarios.text: {Pf} has been unusually quiet all day. At 6pm he checks the calendar. Their anniversary. Today. He has nothing planned. Nothing bought. Nothing.
scenarios.prompt: You forgot your anniversary. It's 6pm.

choices.label: Confess and make it right
choices.text: 'I forgot. I'm an idiot. Give me two hours.' Two hours later there's a picnic on the balcony and a ridiculous home-made card. She forgives him by dessert.

choices.label: Pretend you had a surprise planned

out.text: Somehow he pulls off a reservation and flowers in ninety minutes. She never knows. He tells her years later.
She can tell. The lie is worse than forgetting.

scenarios.title: The Comments About Her
scenarios.text: Strangers in his comments are being cruel about {Pf}: her looks, her clothes, her weight. She's started deleting photos and skipping meals.
scenarios.prompt: Online trolls are hurting your partner.

choices.label: Defend her publicly, loudly
choices.text: His post about her is fierce and loving. The trolls go quiet. Thousands of women thank him. {Pf} cries reading it.

choices.label: Turn off comments and support her privately
choices.text: Comments off, a therapist for her, long walks without phones. She slowly gets better.

scenarios.title: Empty Flat
scenarios.text: His teammates go home to wives and girlfriends and kids. He goes home to an empty flat, a PlayStation and a fridge full of meal-prep boxes. Tonight it feels very quiet.
scenarios.prompt: Single and lonely.

choices.label: Let your friends set you up

out.text: A friend's cousin. Funny, sharp, not into football. They talk until the restaurant closes.
A disaster. She spends the evening asking about his teammates.

choices.label: Get a dog
choices.text: A rescue dog with one ear that doesn't work. The flat is never quiet again. Best decision of the year.

choices.label: Enjoy the freedom
choices.text: He decides to enjoy it: his own schedule, his own music, his own terrible cooking.

scenarios.title: The Dog
scenarios.text: His dog has become famous online: three hundred thousand followers, more than some of his teammates. It has chewed one of his boots. A brand has offered the dog a sponsorship.
scenarios.prompt: Your dog is famous.

choices.label: Accept the dog's sponsorship
choices.text: The dog signs, with a paw print, a deal with a pet-food brand. The money goes to an animal shelter. Everyone is delighted.

choices.label: Keep the dog private
choices.text: He stops posting the dog. The dog does not notice and continues eating boots.

scenarios.title: Too Soon
scenarios.text: Three weeks after the break-up, {F} messages him. She's beautiful, fun, and clearly interested. His friends say it's too soon. His loneliness says otherwise.
scenarios.prompt: A rebound?

choices.label: Go for it
choices.text: It's fun and light and not quite real. After a month they both know it.

choices.label: Give yourself time
choices.text: He says not yet. She says she'll be around. He spends the time with friends and himself.

scenarios.title: She's Moved On
scenarios.text: {EXFLAME} has posted a photo with a new man. They look happy. He's a doctor. Of course he is.
scenarios.prompt: Your ex has moved on.

choices.label: Be happy for her
choices.desc: It's what you'd want for her.
choices.text: He likes the photo. It hurts a little. It's the right thing.

choices.label: Unfollow her
choices.text: He unfollows. Out of sight, slowly out of mind.

choices.label: Message her
choices.hint: Nothing good comes from this message.
choices.text: He sends a message he regrets immediately. She doesn't reply. Her new boyfriend does.

scenarios.title: Her Life Here
scenarios.text: {Pf} followed him abroad. She can't work here without the language. She spends her days alone in the flat. She's started to look sad in a way he doesn't know how to fix.
scenarios.prompt: Your partner is unhappy abroad.

choices.label: Help her build something of her own
choices.text: Language school, a small business selling food from home, friends from the school. Six months later she's busier than he is.

choices.label: Suggest she spends some months back home
choices.text: She goes home for three months. It helps her. It's hard on them.

scenarios.title: She Asks
scenarios.text: {Pf} has been acting strangely all week. Tonight, at their favourite restaurant, she gets down on one knee and holds out a ring. The waiters stop moving. 'You were taking too long,' she says.
scenarios.prompt: Your partner is proposing to you.

choices.label: Say yes
choices.text: He says yes before she finishes. The restaurant applauds. The story goes viral: 'She couldn't wait.'

choices.label: Ask for time
choices.hint: There's no good way to say this.
choices.text: The silence in the restaurant is unbearable. She puts the ring away. Nothing is ever quite the same.

scenarios.title: The Morning of the Wedding
scenarios.text: The wedding is today. At 7am: the photographer has cancelled, {DAD} has locked himself out of his hotel room in his underwear, and a gossip site has published the guest list.
scenarios.prompt: Wedding-day chaos.

choices.label: Laugh and roll with it
choices.text: {BFf} takes the photos on his phone. {DAD} gets a spare key and a story for life. The guest list doesn't matter. It's perfect.

choices.label: Fix everything yourself
choices.text: He spends the morning on the phone fixing things. It all works. He's exhausted and slightly sweaty in the photos. Married.

scenarios.title: The In-Laws
scenarios.text: {Pf}'s parents are coming to stay. For a month. Her father has opinions about football. Her mother has opinions about everything else.
scenarios.prompt: Your in-laws are staying for a month.

choices.label: Make them feel completely at home
choices.text: Tours, dinners, a match from the directors' box. By the end, her father wears his shirt to bed.

choices.label: Survive it
choices.text: He survives. Barely. Day nineteen was the hardest.

scenarios.title: Something Together
scenarios.text: {Pf} has an idea: a small charity together, for kids from both their hometowns. Something that belongs to both of them, not to football.
scenarios.prompt: Start a project with your partner?

choices.label: Do it together
choices.text: Their small charity funds a hundred school uniforms in its first year. They spend Sunday nights planning it, which turns out to be the most romantic part of the week.

choices.label: Support her doing it
choices.text: He funds it and lets her run it. She's brilliant at it.

scenarios.title: 'Saw Your Game'
scenarios.text: After the match, a message from {F}: 'Saw your game. That second-half run was something.' She's never mentioned football before. She's been watching for him.
scenarios.prompt: Your crush is paying attention.

choices.label: Invite her to the next home match
choices.text: She comes. She cheers at the wrong moments and doesn't care. Afterwards, in the car park, it's clear: this is something.

choices.label: Keep it to texting
choices.text: They text every night. It's warm and slow and a little frustrating.

scenarios.title: Fading
scenarios.text: {F}'s replies are getting shorter. Hours between messages. Then a whole day. Whatever this was is fading.
scenarios.prompt: Your crush is losing interest.

choices.label: Make one real effort
choices.desc: A proper date. A real conversation.

out.text: She says yes. The date reminds them both why they started. It's back on.
She says she's met someone else. She's sorry.

choices.label: Let it go
choices.text: He lets it fade. No drama. A little sad.

scenarios.title: The Diagnosis
scenarios.text: {Pf} has been tired for months. The doctors have found something. Treatable, they say, but it'll be a long road: hospital visits, treatment, bad days.
scenarios.prompt: Your partner is seriously ill.

choices.label: Be there for every appointment
choices.hint: The club will have to understand.
choices.text: He's there for every appointment, every bad night. He misses matches. The club, to its credit, never complains. {Pf} recovers. They're stronger than ever.

choices.label: Hire the best care and visit when you can
choices.hint: She needs you, not just doctors.
choices.text: The best doctors, the best clinic. He visits when he can. She recovers. She also remembers the empty chairs.

scenarios.title: {T} Flirts With {Pf}
scenarios.text: At the squad Christmas party, {T} spends a lot of the evening talking to {Pf}, standing a little too close and laughing a little too loudly. {Pf} looks uncomfortable.
scenarios.prompt: A teammate is flirting with your partner.

choices.label: Step in calmly
choices.desc: Join the conversation, arm around her.
choices.text: He joins them with an arm round {Pf}. {T} gets the message and wanders off. {Pf} squeezes his hand.

out.text: {T} apologises immediately: he'd had too much to drink. Lesson learned.
{T} laughs it off. A rivalry begins.

scenarios.title: The Girl Next Door
scenarios.text: Back home for the holidays, he runs into {F}: the girl from next door he had a crush on at twelve. She's a teacher now. She still laughs exactly the same way.
scenarios.prompt: Your childhood crush, all grown up.

choices.label: Ask her for coffee
choices.text: Coffee becomes dinner. They talk about the old street, the old teachers, the old football in the alley. Something is starting.

choices.label: Just say hello
choices.text: A warm hello, a hug, a promise to stay in touch that neither of them keeps.

scenarios.title: 'Come Home or We're Done'
scenarios.text: {Pf} is done with long distance. 'Either you come home when your contract ends, or we end this now. I'm not waiting another two years.'
scenarios.prompt: Your partner gives you an ultimatum.

choices.label: Promise to come home
choices.text: He promises. He means it. His agent sighs and starts looking at clubs back home.

choices.label: Ask her to come here instead

ok.text: She takes a breath and says yes. She'll come.

bad.text: She says no. And then she says goodbye.

choices.label: Let her go
choices.text: He lets her go. The call ends with both of them crying. The clock he kept on her time zone goes in a drawer.

scenarios.title: The Aftermath
scenarios.text: Weeks after the affair came out, the media hasn't moved on. Talk shows discuss it. His sponsors have gone quiet. Fans hold up signs about it at away games.
scenarios.prompt: The affair scandal won't die.

choices.label: One honest interview
choices.text: He sits down for one long, honest interview. No excuses. The story slowly changes from 'cheat' to 'man who messed up and owned it'.

choices.label: Silence
choices.text: He stays silent. It passes, in time. It never fully disappears.

scenarios.title: Another One?
scenarios.text: {KID} has started asking for a little brother or sister. {Pf} has started giving him a look over breakfast.
scenarios.prompt: A second child?

choices.label: Yes
choices.text: Ten months later, {KID} has a sibling and opinions about sharing. The house has never been louder.

choices.label: One is enough
choices.text: They agree: one is perfect. {KID} sulks for a week and then forgets.

scenarios.title: Her Success
scenarios.text: {Pf}'s business has taken off. She's been featured in a magazine. People have started calling {J} '{Pf}'s husband' at her events. He finds he loves it.
scenarios.prompt: Your partner is a success in her own right.

choices.label: Be her biggest fan
choices.text: He goes to every event, holds her bag, beams in the background. The photo of him doing it goes viral.

choices.label: Invest in her business
choices.text: He invests. She doubles the business in a year and pays him back with interest, to make a point.

scenarios.title: The Baby Photos
scenarios.text: A tabloid has offered a fortune for the first photos of his newborn. Photographers have been seen outside the hospital. {Pf} is terrified.
scenarios.prompt: The press want photos of your baby.

choices.label: Release one photo yourself, on your terms
choices.desc: Take the value out of it.
choices.text: He posts one beautiful photo with a request for privacy. The tabloids lose interest. {Pf} relaxes.

choices.label: Legal action and total privacy
choices.text: Lawyers, security, blurred faces. The child grows up out of the spotlight. It's worth every penny.

scenarios.title: Old Friends
scenarios.text: Years after the divorce, {EXFLAME} calls. Not to rekindle anything, just to talk. Their old dog has died. She thought he should know.
scenarios.prompt: Your ex-wife calls after years.

choices.label: Talk for as long as she needs
choices.text: They talk for two hours about the dog, the old flat, the good years. It's the most peaceful conversation they've ever had.

choices.label: Keep it short and kind
choices.text: He thanks her for telling him. It's kind and brief. That's enough.

scenarios.title: The Note
scenarios.text: He finds a note in his kit bag before an away match, in {Pf}'s handwriting. Three lines. He reads it on the bus, then again, then puts it in his wallet.
scenarios.prompt: A love note from your partner.

choices.label: Write one back
choices.text: He writes one back and hides it in her handbag. It becomes their thing: notes in bags, for years.

choices.label: Score and do a celebration for her
choices.text: He scores and makes a heart with his hands to the camera. She watches at home and cries.

scenarios.title: She Didn't Sign Up for This
scenarios.text: {Pf} was stopped in the supermarket by a stranger asking about their relationship. Then another. She hasn't left the flat in three days.
scenarios.prompt: Your partner is struggling with your fame.

choices.label: Move somewhere quieter
choices.desc: A gated home away from the centre.
choices.text: They move somewhere quiet with a garden. She starts going out again, slowly.

choices.label: Make your social media more private
choices.desc: Fewer posts about life at home.
choices.text: He stops posting anything personal. The attention on her fades. His follower growth slows. Worth it.

scenarios.title: The Song
scenarios.text: He wants to tell {Pf} he loves her for the first time. {BFf} suggests doing it with a song at karaoke. {BFf} is not a reliable source of romantic advice.
scenarios.prompt: How do you say 'I love you' for the first time?

out.text: He sings, badly, with total commitment. {Pf} laughs so hard she cries, then says it back.
Someone films it. It's online by morning. {Pf} still says it back, but she makes him promise never to sing again.

choices.label: Just say it, quietly
choices.text: He says it on a walk home. Simple. She stops, smiles and says it back.
